A copper spout and a cup, hung on the side of a log. It only works on a living tree: natural leaves above the log (a log in a wall, or under placed leaves, gives nothing). Every 10 seconds it drips:
- Jungle log: 25 mB of Latex into its 1,000 mB tank.
- Spruce log: a 50% chance of a Pine Resin.
- Any other log: a 15% chance of a Pine Resin.
It holds up to 16 Pine Resin. Take the Latex with a bucket and the resin by hand, or let a hopper under it or a conduit empty it.

# Pine Resin
The Infuser takes Pine Resin in its additive slot in place of Creosote: one per plank, four per log or wood. No Carbonizer needed for treated wood. Two Pine Resin and a Kelp craft into a Slimeball.
# Latex
Dry it into Raw Rubber in the Grain Dryer, or react 250 mB with a Lime Dye in the Chemical Reactor for 2 Slimeballs. Every rate is in the farming.resinTap config.
